note: The Claude Directory listing icon. scripts/build-claude-directory.ts copies icon.png to assets/icon.png in the generated package only if its size and SHA-512 equal this record and it meets the directory's listing-icon rule (a square PNG, 512 to 2048 px a side, under 2 MB). SHA-512 is the only integrity authority (security/integrity-policy.json). The directory reads the icon once, when a plugin is first saved or submitted, so these bytes are deliberate and changing them is a listing decision.

source.describes: The WalletWall brick-wallet mark, 496 x 496 RGBA. The same source as canvas/brand/walletwall-brick-wallet-96.png.

transform: Alpha-composited onto an opaque WalletWall stone ground (#E9D3AD) at 496 x 496, converted to RGB, resized to 1024 x 1024 with Pillow 12.3.0 LANCZOS and saved as PNG with optimize. Not redrawn, recoloured or cropped. Running that recipe on the source reproduces these bytes exactly.
approval: The same bytes are WalletWall's owner-approved app icon. The WalletWall owner approved them for the Claude Directory listing on 2026-11-25.
